name: 04-clinic-bookings
idea: A booking service for a network of four physiotherapy clinics. Patients book appointments with a specific therapist, reschedule or cancel them, and receive a reminder 24 hours before. Clinics publish their availability; a booking must never double-book a therapist. Staff can mark an appointment as attended or no-show, which feeds a monthly report. Patient records are health data, so retention, access and deletion rules matter and every read of a record must be auditable. The service is the system of record for appointments and is called by the clinic's own website and by the reception desk tool.
